title: Aegis fleet policy (fleet.json)
description: The policy the fleet verifier runs from (gateway/aegisd/fleet.py; plain JSON, or the same bytes inside a signed policy, docs/audit-and-policy.md). The verifier ignores keys it does not know ("note" is the usual one), so objects here are open; within a key it is strict: a value it does not know is refused, never read as the default. What it refuses up front (fleet.py policy_errors, `fleet.py check`) is encoded below. A signed policy's JSON must also have no name twice in any object, which a schema cannot say. docs/data-formats.md.
$comment: Aegis 1.1 as read. 1.2: entry keys "disabled" and "min_trust": see docs/data-formats.md once v12-verifier lands.

timeout_s.description: seconds to wait for one endpoint's answer

admit_ttl_s.description: seconds an admission lives in the enforcement set unless refreshed; 0 or absent: derived from the interval and the entries (fleet.py admit_ttl)

enforce_cmd.description: argv of the enforcement hook, run with the entry's name and admit|quarantine appended and AEGIS_ADMIT_TTL in the environment; on a PC verifier only with --enforce

endorsers.description: the keys whose endorsement records this policy trusts (common/endorsement.py trusted); one malformed entry refuses them all

max_endorsement_age_s.description: applies to every entry that does not set its own

attestation_results.description: only true turns on a signed attestation result for every verdict

audit_log.description: true: the signed audit log with the default settings; false or null: none; an object: the settings it names, the rest default. Any other value: no log is kept and the verifier says so at error priority.

name.description: becomes part of file names; at most 64, no leading dot

allowed.description: every component the evidence reports must match one of these (type, measurement and, where given, signer)

iak_pub_pem.description: path (relative to the policy) of the PSA initial attestation key, PEM SubjectPublicKeyInfo, P-256

pq_pub_file.description: path of the device's ML-DSA-65 public key, hex

pq_pub_sha256.description: SHA-256 of that key: the policy names the key it means

profile.description: the claims profile the device must report; plain-claims kinds only

allow_dev_profile.description: only true admits the development profile aegis-zynqmp-optee-devhuk-v1

evidence_format.description: ask for standard evidence (PQEAT); absent: the older quote (PQCHAL), or CHAL for kind psa

transcript.description: a session only through the exchange bound to the appraised quote

endorsement.description: admit only with an endorsement record by a trusted endorser for exactly the pinned key

endorsement_file.description: where the record is (JSON or COSE form: its first byte says which)

provision.description: issue an ML-KEM-768 session credential to the admitted endpoint (aegis-pq and the plain-claims kinds)

verifier_pin_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the verifier key the endpoint's firmware pins; a PC verifier issues credentials only where this names its own key

address_from.description: written by provision/aegis_provision.py reference; not read by the verifier

then.description: kind psa: the token's ES256 key is required (unsigned tokens are refused); the post-quantum keys are refused
one key for every chip: admitted only on request, and no endorsement can name one device

type.description: the component's name as the evidence reports it (SPE, NSPE, APP, ...)

measurement_value.description: lower-case hex, as the verifier compares it

signer_id.description: if given, the component's signer must be this; a component without a signer (EAT without authorities) then does not match

pk_file.description: the endorser's ML-DSA-65 public key, hex, path relative to the policy
